title: Unicon primitive contract
description: How the harness and a primitive image talk. The harness starts one sandboxed container from the step's image and mounts one working directory into it: inputs.json and the input files under in/ go in, and outputs.json and the output files under out/ come back when the container exits. This schema describes both files. A primitive reads one directory and writes one directory; it never sees the forge, the plan or the network.

inputs_file.description: inputs.json, written by the harness before the container starts.

schema_version.description: The contract version this file is written against. A primitive refuses a version it does not speak.

step.description: The id of the plan step this container runs, for the primitive's own log.

inputs.description: One entry per input the primitive declares, keyed by the input name.

outputs_file.description: outputs.json, written by the primitive before it exits. The harness checks it against the outputs the primitive declares before any later step sees it.

schema_version.description: The contract version this file is written against, the same number as in inputs.json.

outputs.description: One entry per output the primitive declares, keyed by the output name. A file output names a path under out/.

error.description: Set when the primitive could not do its work at all, in one sentence for a person. A failed compile is an outcome, not an error; this is for a missing input or a broken image.

value.description: One input or output value. Text, a number and a boolean are carried as themselves; a file is an object naming its path; a list of files is a list of those objects.

file.description: A file in the working directory. The path is relative to the directory root: under in/ for an input, under out/ for an output.
